newsitem.title: USA: Wells Fargo files $750 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Wells Fargo files $750 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Wells Fargo & Co filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday for up to $750 million in preferred and other securities.

The offering, called Cumultative Quarterly Income Preferred Securities (Series A QUIPS), represents interests in Wells Fargo Capital I, a business trust owned by the San Francisco-based bank holding company.
The offering also includes debt securities, preferred stock, common stock and depositary shares of Wells Fargo.
Net proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through Goldman, Sachs & Co.
